# Aunt Atossa

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v3 ch.Evening P11](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0011)</sub>
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Aunt Atossa has gray hair, which is kept in a decidedly untidy fashion. She wears a faded old wrapper.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021)_

## Personality

Aunt Atossa is a thoroughly disagreeable woman who consistently goes out of her way to cause friction. She is noted for her malicious nature, which corrupts the atmosphere around her, as well as a sharp, sarcastic demeanor so ingrained that it is said it would persist even after her death.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)_

## History

Aunt Atossa was left very poor and lonely after her husband died, leading the Wrights to take her into their home. During [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's return to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visited Aunt Atossa to drop off jelly before going to see the terminally ill [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 ch.Life P2](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0002), [v3 ch.Life P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 ch.Life P5](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0005), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), +73 more_

## Quotes

> "I suppose you got that notion out of some of those silly magazines you read so many of. I wonder your mother allows you. But she always spoiled you. We all thought when George married her she wouldn’t be a suitable wife for him."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P30](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0030)

> "Well, I suppose you can’t find much amusement talking to an old woman like me. It’s such a pity the boys ain’t home."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P32](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0032)

> "Mrs. Andrews was telling me you were home. She said you had improved a good deal."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)

> "I never fancy your mother’s jelly—she always makes it too sweet. However, I’ll try to worry some down. My appetite’s been dreadful poor this spring. I’m far from well,"
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P26](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0026)

> "I hear you are to be married in June, Diana."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P36](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-atossa--diana-barry.md)

Aunt Atossa is the great-aunt of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). During a visit home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stop by Aunt Atossa's home to drop off jelly for her before heading off to visit their ill friend, [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).

- Relative of — great-aunt  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018)</sub>

### [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-atossa--josie-pye.md)

Aunt Atossa is related to [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) as a cousin to Josie's mother. Their shared connection is tied to the broader social network of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) families.

- Relative of — Aunt Atossa is cousin to Josie Pye's mother  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)</sub>
